title: MeasurementFlint
description: This mod brings a new stone world to the game!
body: **This mod brings a new stone world to the game! To get there, you need to create a portal made of gold blocks and set it on fire with a special flint. However, creating a portal is not an easy and costly task. You will need from 10 to 14 blocks of gold. And for the flint, you will need 1 iron ingot, 1 diamond, 1 gold ingot, 1 emerald and, of course, the flint itself.**
